description: Defines the QuicChromiumPacketReader class for reading QUIC packets over a socket, including its nested Visitor class, constants, and private members.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
classes.description: Handles reading of QUIC packets from a socket with configurable yield conditions.

classes.name: Visitor
classes.description: Interface for handling read errors and incoming packets.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins reading packets from the socket.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when a read operation completes.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a read operation to determine if reading should continue.

methods.name: OnReadMultiplePacketComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of multiple packet read.

methods.name: ProcessMultiplePacketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a multiple packet read.
